evals.prompt: help us set up a disaster recovery plan for losing our primary database
evals.expected_output: Starts by getting business-approved RTO and RPO targets before designing anything, picks a failover pattern matched to the actual feared failure mode, and requires the recovery plan to be stored and reachable independent of the primary infrastructure.

evals.prompt: our backups show green every night but we've never actually restored one
evals.expected_output: Flags that an unrestored backup is an unverified belief, not a backup; recommends automating periodic restore-and-verify into an isolated environment, alerting as loudly on restore failure as backup failure, and testing restore into a different account/region.

evals.prompt: our architect announced a DR failover drill for next tuesday, he'll run it himself
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: an announced, architect-run drill tests nothing about real conditions - recommends rotating who runs the drill (not the primary system owner), timing it end-to-end against the stated RTO, and including boring parts like DNS cutover and cert reissuance.
